_comment: Hologram models (VECTOR's format: vector's tools/holo/collection.py and assets/holo/README.md). Boxes are [x0,x1, y0,y1, z0,z1] in fractions of the normalised bounding box (y up, front +z); a face goes to the first part whose box holds its centroid, else to the part with rest=true. bind names the live reading a part shows (VECTOR's holo/bind.py), empty for a part that only shapes the model. Sources are in src/; the baked NAME.holo.npz sit next to this file. Rebake: ~/.local/share/bromigos/venv/bin/python <vector>/tools/holo/bake.py --root THIS_DIR --preview

parts.label: TAIL AND PENNANT
parts.hint: The tall fin and its long ribbon pennant: every post in the Drift knows the Petrel by its lamps

parts.label: DUCTED FANS
parts.hint: Two ducted fans under the wings: Pip flies storm bands, cloud decks and dust skies between Sunder, Cinder and every other post

parts.label: CARGO POD
parts.hint: The cargo pod clamped under the belly: Tamsin Rook's salvage, Brask's castings and Hollis Crane's drawings, flown from post to post

parts.label: WINGS
parts.hint: Straight, much-patched wings in faded orange and cream

parts.label: COCKPIT
parts.hint: A small, fast courier with a bubble canopy. Of all the Lamplighters, Pip has met the most of them, and never stayed long anywhere
